criteria.text: I can decline cancellation or replacement before any agent stops, record changes, claim release or new run.

Cancelling a run by its ID asks first, confirms its live agent stopped, saves cancelled state for the phone and releases only its claim while preserving its worktree, branch, journal, artifacts and every PR without pushing.
After I confirm replacement of the current holder, it becomes cancelled before its claim is released and a distinct workflow run starts with new worktree and branch; the old work remains readable.
A replacement naming another run refuses before confirmation or effects, and never cancels the current holder or the other run.

An already-assigned issue refusal identifies the holder ID, workflow, step or stage, state and age, and shows current-alpha status, open and applicable approve commands plus the exact requested replacement command.
A scope recommendation to use feature stays with its reason, and both its approval gate and the holding-run refusal show it with the exact feature replacement command without switching automatically.
Existing issue-reference cancellation still works, and an already-cancelled run or a delayed completion cannot cancel again or change the replacement.
